headline: Vesuvius plc files SEBI takeover disclosure for Foseco India
sum: Vesuvius plc, global industrial materials player, has filed a substantial acquisition / takeover disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) for Foseco India Limited, signalling a material stake acquisition or control transaction in the specialty refractories and foundry chemicals manufacturer.
implication: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a mandatory gate for any acquirer crossing 25% threshold or announcing an open offer; this filing confirms Vesuvius's regulatory intent and triggers public-company disclosure timelines, open-offer terms, and minority-protection mechanics under the 2011 Takeover Code.
detail: Vesuvius plc, a London-listed industrial materials and engineered services firm, has disclosed a substantial acquisition in Foseco India Limited under SEBI's mandatory takeover framework. The filing under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 signals either a creeping acquisition above 25% or a formal tender offer. Foseco India is a leading Indian manufacturer of refractories, foundry chemicals and metallurgical products, catering to steel, foundry and non-ferrous industries. The disclosure has been filed with the NSE, triggering public-company transparency and minority shareholder safeguards.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition by acquirer to stock exchange and company; triggers open-offer obligations above 25% threshold.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 3 (Definitions: 'acquisition of control')
framework.note: Defines control thresholds (25% for listed company); central to triggering takeover code applicability.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 10 (Open Offer Obligation)
framework.note: Acquirer crossing 25% must make open offer to minority shareholders at 26 weeks' highest closing price or negotiated price.

framework.ref: Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 - Section 23A & Rules (Stock Exchange listing)
framework.note: Governs listed company takeover disclosure requirements and stock-exchange reporting.
If Vesuvius or Foseco subsidiaries are related entities, disclosure and board approval required; minimal application here but check corporate structure.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) - Regulations on FDI/cross-border acquisition
framework.note: Vesuvius is UK-listed; any UK parent acquisition of Indian listed equity above thresholds may require RBI/FIPB clearance if deemed FDI.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 4 (Exemptions & Creeping Acquisition)
framework.note: Governs exemptions from open-offer for acquisitions <5% per year (creeping); clarifies which acquisitions are carved out.

framework.ref: Listing Rules (NSE & BSE) - Corporate Governance & Material Event Disclosure
framework.note: Foseco India must disclose material event (change of control / substantial stake) to exchanges within regulatory timelines.

conditions: Filing under SEBI Regulation 31(4) confirms substantial acquisition threshold breached or takeover announced
Open offer obligation triggered if acquisition crosses 25% of voting capital
Minority shareholder protections (26-week trading window, pricing floor) apply
approvals: SEBI Takeover Regulations compliance (Regulation 31 disclosure filed)
Stock exchange (NSE/BSE) approval/notification of open offer (if applicable)
Foseco India board acknowledgement of disclosure

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure gate for control acquisitions; filing confirms materiality and public-company status
Open-offer obligation triggered if Vesuvius crosses 25% threshold; defines offer period, pricing, and minority protections
